result.title: SPAR: Experience-Driven Strategy Evolution in Multi-Session B2B Sales
result.summary: B2B outbound sales involves high transaction values and relationship-based trust, so closing a deal typically requires multiple rounds of outreach building on prior context. Existing LLM-based sales agents operate within single sessions and cannot carry forward context or refine strategies from experience. Methods that do learn from experience store lessons as unstructured text and treat all outcomes as equally informative, with no mechanism to distinguish a flawed strategy from an external factor. We propose SPAR, a self-evolving framework that models selling strategies as testable hypotheses and refines them without parameter updates. A double-loop architecture lets an inner loop adapt to individual merchants through episodic memory while an outer loop evolves a shared strategy playbook through causal attribution and hypothesis-driven evolution. In a live A/B test on the 1688 platform with over 200,000 merchants, SPAR achieves +15.8% conversion lift and +35.8% high-intent merchant growth. Human evaluation by domain experts rates SPAR at 4.62 out of 5 on overall sales quality, the highest among all methods.

AI.brief_summary: SPAR 将 B2B 销售策略建模为可检验假设，用内循环情景记忆适配单个商家、外循环借助因果归因演化共享策略手册，在 1688 平台 20 万商家 A/B 测试中报告转化提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其区分「策略缺陷」与「外部因素」的因果归因及跨会话经验累积，可能为 LVR 中轨迹贡献分配与内部状态信息保留的核查提供线索，但非视觉推理研究。
